extractionNote: Factual genre labels and pixel coordinates extracted from a pinned public mirror of the 2023-12-04 Every Noise map. The source HTML and audio previews are not redistributed.

axes.horizontal: Every Noise left-to-right reference coordinate; described by the original project as denser/more atmospheric to spikier/bouncier.
axes.vertical: Every Noise top-to-bottom reference coordinate; described by the original project as more mechanical/electric to more organic.
